The Lab Card is an item that is obtained as part of the Hidden Vials quest in the Snowy Peaks.

Description

The Lab Card is an item that allows players into the second floor of the Observatory. It is a blue card with a white strip and white text. The text states "C-09" on the right side of the card, and Alan Burk's name on the left side of the card.

On the reverse side of the card, the text is mirrored, but there is an additional barcode. Most of the barcode is obstructed, leaving only two thin strips of red dots. Connecting these to each other vertically reveals the full barcode, which is encoded using Code 39. The barcode resolves to *HERRING*.

The barcode is a reference to a red herring, something deliberately intended to mislead or distract from the original question. The barcode itself is red, and the encoded text is *HERRING*.

Obtaining

Obtaining the Lab Card requires the player to get into the Snowy Peaks. They must find the Lab, and speak to to the Unknown Person within the lab.

They must then find five separate vials within the Snowy Peaks, and return them to the Unknown Person, who will give them the Lab Card in return for the vials. These vials can be collected in any order the player desires, as long as they are all returned to the Unknown Person at the same time.

WARNING: this quest will expire with time. If you take too long to gather all of the vials they will respawn and you will need to go back to the lab and talk to the Unknown Person again.

The locations of the vials are as follows:

Vial #1 is located on the far left of the biome.

Starting from the map at the desert entrance take the path to the left and take the immediate ramp on the right to the very top, go down the dip then up the ramp on the left, follow it to the corner of that area and the first vial will be waiting for you to claim

Starting from the Lab, go between the two ramps on either side, and continue upwards, when at the two ramps go up the right one, and continue upwards until you get to the frozen Y lake, follow the shore left and cross the lake once arriving at the part where it becomes a waterfall, from that point on, take the first ramp on your left and go all the way upwards, once at the dip, go down, up the first ramp on your left and follow the edge till the corner, your vial will be waiting

Vial #2 is located on the right side of the biome.

From the Lab, Follow the same directions as mentioned in Vial #1 to get to the frozen Y lake, cross immediately, be careful not the fall in the holes in the ice! Hug the right wall until you reach the ramp and head up it. Continue along the path and take the first ramp on the left, follow the series of ramps until you reach the top. Once at the top travel straight ahead to the edge of the cliff where the vial should be sitting.

From the desert map, head up the slope past the ramps until you arrive at the frozen Y lake, cross it and continue straight, staying on the snow until you get to the ramp after the ski lift, head up the ramp and follow the walls until you take the next ramp on the left following the series of ramps until you reach the top. Once at the top, travel straight ahead to the edge of the cliff where the vial should be sitting

Vial #3 is on the right of the biome near Vial #2

Starting from the first ramp from Vial #2's Taiga directions, Follow the lake until you see what looks like a cliff, but the edge is snowy, this is where the path dips down extremely sharply. Most cars do not have the acceleration to get back up this cliff after going down, so if you are driving, make sure to leave your vehicle at the top of the dip and carry the vial back up manually.

Down the cliff on the rocks to the left, the Vial is sitting in the middle of the rock.

Starting from the Frozen Y lake, Follow it until you get to an area where the edge looks like a snow covered cliff ledge, the path dips down extremely sharply, but if you scoot forward car near the edge, you will see the vial, do not drive down however as most cars do not have the appropriate acceleration to go back up. Instead walk down the path and carry the vial back up

Vial #4 is also located on the right side of the biome near Vial #2.

From the first ramp in Vial #2' s Taiga directions, turn left and Head up to the Ski Lift, sharply turn right once you reach the cable car station. Hug the right wall until you see the vial!

From the sharp dip for vial #3's Frozen lake Directions, continue following the lake until you see the sign for the ski lift, turn left and Head up to it, sharply turn right once you reach the cable car station. Hug the right wall until you see the vial!

Vial #5 is located on the far left of the biome on the ramp above the entrance to the lab.

From the Lab, hug the left wall until you pass a ramp, head up this ramp and when possible turn right, there you will see a vial waiting for you to bring to the stranger.


It is encouraged to use the free cam option if players struggle to find the vials.

Trivia

  • When hovering over the Lab Card, one of the interaction options is "? ? ?". This option currently does nothing.
  • When inspecting the card, the description says "LabCard_description". This is likely due to the fact that the item is new, and no localized strings for the description have been made.
  • The card is equippable in a new "pocket" slot, which currently can contain either this or the Red version. Although it still has no function
  • The vials can not be saved onto your plot, kept in crates, or stored in drawers.
